crossRefs.note: When the demon was cast out, the mute man spoke. The multitudes marveled, saying, “Nothing like this has ever been seen…
Then one possessed by a demon, blind and mute, was brought to him and he healed him, so that the blind and mute man…
All the multitudes were amazed, and said, “Can this be the son of David?”
They were all amazed, so that they questioned among themselves, saying, “What is this? A new teaching? For with…
They were astonished beyond measure, saying, “He has done all things well. He makes even the deaf hear, and the mute…
and they were astonished at his teaching, for his word was with authority.
The seventy returned with joy, saying, “Lord, even the demons are subject to us in your name!”
These signs will accompany those who believe: in my name they will cast out demons; they will speak with new languages;
so that even handkerchiefs or aprons were carried away from his body to the sick, and the diseases departed from them…
who is at the right hand of God, having gone into heaven, angels and authorities and powers being made subject to him.

parallels.note: —because they said, “He has an unclean spirit.”

translations.web: Amazement came on all, and they spoke together, one with another, saying, “What is this word? For with authority and power he commands the unclean spirits, and they come out!”
translations.bsb: All the people were overcome with amazement and asked one another, “What is this message? With authority and power He commands the unclean spirits, and they come out!”
translations.kjv: And they were all amazed, and spake among themselves, saying, What a word is this! for with authority and power he commandeth the unclean spirits, and they come out.
translations.asv: And amazement came upon all, and they spake together, one with another, saying, What is this word? for with authority and power he commandeth the unclean spirits, and they come out.
